svg.title: How much of the weight lost was lean mass, not fat?
svg.desc: How much of the weight lost was lean mass, not fat?. 8-day water-only fast (1 study, bioimpedance (BIA)): 67%. 10-day water-only fast (1 study, DXA scan): 57%. 10-day ~250 kcal fast: all lean tissue (16 healthy men; includes water and glycogen): 60.7%. …of which metabolically active tissue (same study, after removing water and glycogen): 25%. Viral 14-day water fast, as posted (one person, one DEXA pair; not verified): 35%. Semaglutide or tirzepatide, drug-only arms (4 trials, DXA, 16 to 48 weeks): 28.9 to 34%. Rule of thumb for diets (“quarter rule”) (Heymsfield 2014 review): 25%.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
